subject.title: fix(agents): drop stale internal orphan prompts

question: Should maintainers keep this stale-internal-drop branch as the preferred landing candidate, or close it in favor of the proof-positive preserve-as-context strategy in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90759?
rationale: Both open PRs target the same stale-reply issue but encode different session-state semantics, and automation cannot choose the product contract for orphaned internal handoff content.

options.title: Choose canonical strategy first
options.body: Pause merge/close action until maintainers decide between dropping selected internal orphan content and preserving orphaned user text as context-only.

options.title: Keep this branch with proof
options.body: Require redacted embedded-agent logs or terminal output proving the six-tool drop path and `sessions_send` preservation before merge.

options.title: Supersede with broader candidate
options.body: If maintainers prefer the proof-positive preserve-as-context repair, close this PR as superseded by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90759.

recommendation.title: Choose canonical strategy first
recommendation.body: Pause merge/close action until maintainers decide between dropping selected internal orphan content and preserving orphaned user text as context-only.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is closest to the queued-user prompt preservation invariant introduced in PR #65478 and the current input-provenance helper history.
